## Security, review and release checks
- [ ] No Hitachi, other agent scope, protected champion or organizer files modified without handoff
- [ ] No secrets, signed NDA, private chat export, private receipts or hidden scores

- [ ] git diff --check and path ownership reviewed
- [ ] No auto-merge/push main/cloud spend/organizer submission
